model.catLabel: Operator's manual and parts list, SN 3309 and up (PDF)
model.note: Part outlines are traced from a 1st Products photo of a UA60 with the SB60 seed box (the tractor has been cut out) and are approximate. The belt drive, centre gearbox, PTO driveline, jackshaft and hitch sit behind the seed box and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from the AERA-vator operator's manual and parts list PB REV 0422 (UA60 SN 3309 and up), which covers Seeder 1 (SN 3831). AU parts through Nuturf (1st Products distributor); most have no public AU price.

seedbox.name: SB60 seed box
seedbox.desc: Seed box that turns the AERA-vator into a seeder: 6.7 cu ft (about 190 L) hopper, 15 outlets. Keep the seed cups clean and dry; clean off seed and dirt after use and store dry. SB60 parts are on the seed box pages of the same parts manual (the old Notion numbers UA-SB-AS, UA-SB-LG and UA-SB-MW are placeholders, not 1st Products numbers).

seedtubes.name: Seed outlets and tubes
seedtubes.desc: 15 outlets from the seed box. Clean them out with the seed cups after use and store dry.

seeddrive.name: Seed box end plate and drive
seeddrive.desc: End plate of the SB60 seed box carrying the seed drive. The chain idler must have no slack after the first 50 ft (15 m) of seeding: re-tighten it. Oil the chain transmission as needed with multipurpose oil.

beltdrive.name: Belt drive (4 x BX46)
beltdrive.desc: Four BX46 V-belts (AE50-093, buy as a matched set of 4) take drive from the centre gearbox to the tine shaft. Check tension after the first hour, then every 40 h: about 80 N (18 lb) push midway between the pulleys gives about 10 mm (3/8 in) deflection. Tighten at the idler locknut and don't over-tension: over-tensioned belts fail early and overload the bearings. Yearly: check for wear and cracks and replace as a set. Idler UA80-071 (centred, left) with spacer UA24-025. BX46 is a B-section cogged belt, 46 in inside length (17 mm top width, about 1205 mm): Gates, Bando and Optibelt BX46 are standard stock. Keep the belt cover fitted and all guards and shields chained. The old Notion row (single belt UA-DB560, 'check monthly') is wrong.

frame.name: Main frame (UA60)
frame.desc: Universal AERA-vator UA60: 60 in (about 1.5 m) working width, 510 lb (231 kg) less shaft, 9 holes per sq ft. Seeder 1 is serial 3831, so the SN 3309 and up manual (PB REV 0422) applies. Grease fittings are 1/4-28 (HW50008THD.F). After use clean off dirt and seed; at the end of the season clean off all dirt and grease and lubricate everything per the lubrication pages.

shaft.name: AERA-vator tine shaft
shaft.desc: Rotor shaft 60 (AE26-021) carrying rotors with threaded-in tines: 144 tines per UA60 shaft. Tine vibration 800 cycles/min at 540 PTO rpm, side-to-side tine travel 1-3/8 in (35 mm), vibrating depth 3-3/4 in (95 mm). Before use: tines tight and not worn short, no missing tines or lockwashers. Replace worn tines across the shaft for even depth. Rotor bearings AE50-090 (1-1/8 in hex bore, double-sealed tapered roller, 3 per shaft) are sealed: no grease, check for play and noise only; keep the cones together when removing or the internal seals are ruined. External rotor seals AE50-005 and internal 3 in snap rings AE50-029, 12 of each per shaft. On reassembly torque the rotor shaft nut to 475 Nm (350 ft-lb), turning the rotors as it tightens; if a rotor locks, the bearing adapters are not phased 180 deg. Rotor assembly without tines SE81-002, rotor only SE80-015. The old Notion rows (UCF205 bearing 'grease weekly', UA-TH / UA-TB / UA-TS-60) are not 1st Products parts.

roller.name: Rear roller
roller.desc: Roller bearings are sealed: check for play and noise only. Clean off dirt after use.

rollerframe.name: Roller frame
rollerframe.desc: Frame members carrying the rear roller and turnbuckle. Check for loose fasteners and clean off dirt after use.

turnbuckle.name: Roller turnbuckle
turnbuckle.desc: Put anti-seize on the turnbuckle threads as required (weekly in use).

gearbox.name: Centre gearbox (AE54-018)
gearbox.desc: 1:1 right-angle gearbox. SAE 90W gear lube, filled to the side check plug (capacity not stated). Before use, with the machine level, oil should just flow from the right-hand side plug; top up through the top plug and do not overfill. Run low or overfilled, the gearbox is damaged. All gearbox plugs in. Gearbox service is a dealer job per 1st Products (no change interval given); best practice is to change the oil every 2 to 3 seasons or if contaminated. Check for leaks yearly. The old Notion row ('EP90 / 80W-140, change annually or 300 h') is not from the manual.

driveline.name: PTO driveline (AE55-082)
driveline.desc: 540 rpm PTO, 1-3/8 in spline. Grease (multipurpose) both U-joints every 8 h, the telescoping inner tube every 16 h and the guard plastic bearings every 40 h. PTO shields fitted and chained. Order cross kits and guards by the driveline make on the shaft label. The old Notion 'Cat 4/5 PTO shaft' row is wrong: the UA60 shaft is AE55-082.

hitch.name: 3-point hitch
hitch.desc: Grease the hitch horizontal and vertical swing pivots weekly (decal 'GREASE WEEKLY').

jackshaft.name: Jackshaft and coupler chain
jackshaft.desc: Jackshaft bearing AE50-048 (1-1/8 in bore, sealed: check for play and noise). Likely a UC206-18 insert or a UCF/UCFL206-18 housed unit: read the number off the old bearing, then any bearing house can supply it. Coupler chain AE50-006: oil as required through the top of the jackshaft cover; check the stamped chain size before buying an equivalent.

rake.name: Rake attachment (option)
rake.desc: Rake tine AE50-178, only if the rake attachment is fitted.

grease.name: Lubrication summary
grease.desc: Multipurpose grease: PTO U-joints 8 h, inner tube 16 h, guard bearings 40 h, hitch pivots weekly. Multipurpose oil: coupler chain and seed box chain as required. Anti-seize: turnbuckle threads. SAE 90W: centre gearbox, check before use. Rotor, roller and jackshaft bearings are sealed. No telematics.

sprocket.name: Seed drive sprocket
sprocket.desc: Check the seed drive chain idler has no slack after the first 50 ft (15 m) of seeding and oil the chain transmission as needed (multipurpose oil). SB60 parts are on the seed box pages of the parts manual.

rotor.name: Rotor and tines
rotor.desc: Tines AE50-058 (5/8 NF, forged and hardened, 9/16 x 3-3/4 in), 144 per shaft. Each is held by a 5/8 NF hex nut G5 (HW20020G5PLF) and a 5/8 lockwasher G8 (HW32020G8ZP): torque 285 Nm (210 ft-lb) with the supplied socket AE60T003. The old Notion tine number UA-T560 (3-3/8 in) is wrong. Rotor assembly without tines SE81-002.

AE60T003.name: Tine socket
AE60T003.note: Supplied tool for the tine nuts (285 Nm / 210 ft-lb).

SE81-002 / SE80-015: Rotor assembly w/o tines / rotor only
AE50-090: Rotor bearing 1-1/8 hex bore (double-sealed tapered roller)
AE50-058: Tine 5/8 in NF (9/16 x 3-3/4 in forged & hardened)
